# Dough Intent Coverage: shared test guidance

**Verdict: Confirmed missing test path, bounded to the examined selector command.**

Story: `SEED-126#use-shared-test-guidance`, checked revision `924d9293c767d15f7247402d387ebb7fc8654f85`.

Selected promise: a frontend test author follows the local fixture guidance to the installed shared MakeMe entrypoint. The intended route is `unit-testing/SKILL.md` → `dough-makeme/SKILL.md` → shared entry selection and convention.

One scratch fault changed only the `Dough MakeMe` link in `.agents/skills/unit-testing/SKILL.md:83` from `../dough-makeme/SKILL.md` to `../dough-makeme/SKILL-missing.md`. Fixtures, selection configuration, source tests and assertions were unchanged.

The nearest maintained selection command examined was:

```sh
./scripts/run.sh node .agents/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/test-entry-rules.mjs --project /tmp/dough-seed126-intent-coverage --source frontend/tests/store/noteStore.trashNote.spec.ts
```

Baseline, faulted and restored executions each exited 0 and returned the same resolved selection: `makeMe:true,pageObjects:false`. An independent scratch link-resolution witness followed the local `Dough MakeMe` link: its destination existed at baseline, was missing under the fault, and existed after restoration. Thus the fault broke the author-entry journey while this selector command continued to pass; the command observes source membership and omits the guidance-link transition. It supplies no maintained assertion for that transition. This is not a claim about every check in the repository.

The source's one-time guidance/link walkthrough is separate acceptance evidence and would expose this fault. This scratch result establishes a limit of the examined maintained command, not a defect in the delivered guidance or evidence that the accepted walkthrough failed. No test-suite conversion or permanent absence checker was added.

**Next proof action:** retain repeatable link-resolution proof for the local author entrypoint's connection to installed shared guidance. Keep it distinct from selector membership proof and the one-time removal sweep; the caller owns its disposition.

Setup and restoration: isolated detached worktree at the checked revision; `./scripts/run.sh bash scripts/worktree_setup.sh` completed successfully. The changed file was restored byte-for-byte (SHA-256 `6419f683f0952f8984113e2e98bdb23bf699f767be5544ef51f7288fc0ee39b2`), Git status returned to its original clean state, and the restored selector passed. The scratch worktree was removed and unregistered. The execution checkout was not edited. Detailed run outputs and the fault diff remain in `/tmp/seed126-intent-evidence.json`.

No already-planned correction was identified by this probe. No repair or follow-up was implemented.

- **Test runtime:** no test-runner runtime was available; this probe used a maintained selector command. Its measured wall times were 1.268 s baseline, 1.230 s faulted and 1.163 s restored (3.661 s total).
- **Human effort:** unavailable; no separate human-time record was supplied or collected.
- **Agent effort:** unavailable; no separate active-agent timer distinguishes reasoning from setup and command waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 188118 ms (measured), from 1794478940000 to 1794479128118 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: `924d9293c767d15f7247402d387ebb7fc8654f85`.
The scratch report is accepted for the local author-entry link transition only.
The delivered link is valid, and the accepted one-time 20-link/anchor walkthrough
observes that journey; no delivered defect or invalidated acceptance proof was
found. The selector retains its separate membership responsibility.

`SEED-127#verify-test-guidance-links`, canonical home
`.planning/seeds/SEED-127-verify-test-guidance-links.md#verify-test-guidance-links`,

It has one planned Behavior slice, readiness recorded, and no execution authority.
No existing retrospective follow-up was displaced. This disposition adds no
